purpose: Language-neutral JSON interoperability fixtures. Every SDK/runtime adapter must preserve these semantics without coercion.
rules: Treat absent fields and explicit null as distinct.
Preserve arbitrary-precision quantities as canonical decimal strings, never floating-point numbers.
Preserve Unicode without lossy normalization or replacement.
Treat machine-readable error codes as stable; human-readable messages are not identifiers.

cases.purpose: Unicode and punctuation survive UTF-8 JSON round trips.
Arbitrary-precision blockchain/token quantity remains a string.
Explicit null is not equivalent to an absent field.
Nested arrays, objects, booleans and zero remain typed.
Consumers branch on stable code and HTTP status, not localized message text.
